extension.description: Authoring support for the modular Echo Story platform: EchoScript resources, legacy JSON5, completion, diagnostics, formatting, hovers, snippets, syntax, and references.
command.refreshIndex.title: EchoStory: Refresh Story Index
command.showIndex.title: EchoStory: Show Story Index
command.formatCurrent.title: EchoStory: Format Current File
command.openDocs.title: EchoStory: Open Authoring Docs
configuration.title: EchoStory Engine Authoring
configuration.modRoot.description: Absolute path to the Echo workspace root used for indexing ids, templates, and docs. The default points at D:\JDHSeason\mods.
configuration.storyDataGlob.description: Workspace-root-relative data directory or semicolon-separated directories. The default indexes echo-story-content-pack.
configuration.enableDiagnostics.descript: Enable EchoScript linter diagnostics and legacy JSON5 parse, schema, type, and reference diagnostics.
configuration.validateReferences.descrip: Warn when dialogueId, storyId, npcId, animationId, skin, or camera path references cannot be found in the indexed Echo resources.
configuration.strictUnknownFields.descri: Report unknown fields in known typed objects. Keep disabled when experimenting with new engine fields.
configuration.autoRefreshIndex.descripti: Automatically refresh the Echo resource id index after authoring files change.
configuration.inlayHints.enabled.descrip: Show compact inline reference-kind hints after resolved EchoStory references.
configuration.questVisuals.enabled.descr: Highlight quest_update status values with editor badges and overview ruler markers.
configuration.questVisuals.codeLens.enab: Show quest status CodeLens labels above quest_update objects.
configuration.indexRefreshIntervalSecond: Periodic refresh interval for the story id index.
configuration.formatter.useTabs.descript: Use tabs for JSON5 formatting. This is the default project style.
configuration.formatter.tabSize.descript: Indent size used when formatter tabs are disabled or when VS Code requests spaces.
configuration.formatter.trailingComma.de: Emit trailing commas in formatted JSON5 objects and arrays.
configuration.formatter.quote.descriptio: String quote style for formatted JSON5.
